does: Turn a cold brief into candidate problems, audiences, propositions and risks, then cut the weak ones
refuses: Producing a single idea and calling it the answer; a list of twenty with no cut is the same failure
what_it_does_not_do: Establish that any candidate is true. Every item leaves here labelled inferred

does: Find market, competitor, price, regulatory and channel evidence, with each source's family and blindness named
machinery: research-protocol.md; market-data-collection.md; how-companies-market.md; data/market-data-sources.csv; data/marketing-benchmarks.csv; scripts/research_plan.py
refuses: Three sources from one measurement family presented as triangulation
what_it_does_not_do: Tell you what customers want. Desk evidence describes the market, not the buyer

does: Read actual customer language, objections and buying context from reviews, messages, calls and comments
refuses: Inventing a quote, a persona detail or a review that no source contains
what_it_does_not_do: Establish prevalence. Vivid language from six buyers is a hypothesis, not a share

does: Design or read audience research so a difference has to beat its own margin of error before it counts
refuses: Reporting a gap smaller than the margin of error as a finding
what_it_does_not_do: Fix a leading question. Wording changed between waves makes the comparison invalid at any n

does: Group buyers by differences that change what you would say, sell or charge, and drop the rest
refuses: Demographic segments that produce identical creative; a segment nobody would brief differently is not a segment
what_it_does_not_do: Size the segments. That needs the bottom-up chain in market-data-collection.md

does: Fix the category frame, the buyer, the problem, the difference and the reason to believe it
refuses: A difference the product does not have, and a claim with no evidence row behind it
what_it_does_not_do: Guarantee the frame is winnable. It states the bet and what would prove it wrong

does: Shape what is actually being sold: package, proof, price framing, risk reversal and response path
refuses: Manufactured scarcity, hidden conditions and a discount presented as a mechanism
what_it_does_not_do: Set the price. It needs unit cost and contribution margin, which only the owner has

does: Weld objective, audience, message, channel, format, timing, owner and measurement into one plan
refuses: A channel chosen by habit rather than by where the buyer's decision actually happens
what_it_does_not_do: Promise a result. It states the mechanism and the number that would confirm it

does: Split the money across channels and phases, with each split traced to a benchmark and its sample
refuses: Quoting the 60:40 split, the 9 percent of revenue figure or any benchmark without the population it came from
what_it_does_not_do: Know your margin. Every allocation here is a share of a total the owner must supply

does: Compress everything decided into one job, one buyer, one promise, one proof and one next step
refuses: A brief with two audiences or two promises; that is two briefs pretending to be one
what_it_does_not_do: Fill the fields only the owner knows. Those leave as explicit TBD with the reason

does: Write the copy: search-led long form, ads, page, PDP, email, script, built on a named structure
refuses: Keyword insertion in place of substance, and a heading that promises what the section does not deliver
what_it_does_not_do: Clear the claims. Anything publishable goes through approve with a claim id

does: Measure and repair what makes a draft read machine-written: cadence, uniformity, connectives, icons
refuses: Lowering a target to pass, and adding texture on top of prose that is still flat underneath
what_it_does_not_do: Make weak content interesting. Rhythm cannot rescue a page with nothing in it

does: Write the other language from the brief rather than translating the finished copy
refuses: Word-for-word translation handed over as localisation, and an address register wrong for the buyer
what_it_does_not_do: Check the legal wording in the target market. Regulated claims need a local check

does: Lay the work across a real calendar against the horizon the request actually stated
refuses: Planning 90 days when the request said six weeks, and a cadence nobody in the team can sustain
what_it_does_not_do: Know the team's real capacity. Cross-check against vietnam-operating-reality.md

does: Set hierarchy, grid, crop, scale, spacing, type and reading order, as numbers rather than adjectives
machinery: composition-light-color.md; data/layout-dials.csv; data/composition-grids.csv; data/frame-ratios.csv; scripts/plan_design_options.py; scripts/render_mockup.py; scripts/render_refsheet.py
refuses: Cropping a master into another ratio instead of laying it out again for that ratio
what_it_does_not_do: Settle taste. It settles the quantities; the remaining choice is argued on the render

does: Build or check a palette on hue relationship, lightness separation, chroma budget and contrast
refuses: A wheel scheme presented as a result, and the 85-percent and 80-percent colour statistics
what_it_does_not_do: Know whether the category already owns the colour, or who has registered it

does: Build the mark, wordmark, favicon ladder, banner masters and type scale, checked at the smallest slot
refuses: A mark whose thinnest stroke disappears at 16 pixels, and a logotype exemption claimed for a link
what_it_does_not_do: Clear the trademark. Availability is a search and a lawyer, not arithmetic

does: Build the scene: surface, backdrop, props, light direction and size, depth, and how the product is held
refuses: A light description that contradicts the shadow it would cast
what_it_does_not_do: Source the props. A scene plan is buildable only if someone checks what is on hand

does: Direct real product and lifestyle photography: shot list, light values, crops per channel, continuity
refuses: A shot list with no copy-safe area, on work that will carry copy
what_it_does_not_do: Take the photograph. It hands a photographer something they can execute without asking

does: Turn a brief plus references into provider-ready prompts, then into real images, with locks enforced
machinery: prompt-contracts.md; reference-first-image-flow.md; reference-reading.md; api-image-orchestration.md; provider-compilers.md; scripts/compile_prompt.py; scripts/generate_image.py; data/reference-observations.csv
refuses: Imitating a named living artist, a specific photograph or a distinctive campaign device
what_it_does_not_do: Render legible text on a product. Ask for an unbranded surface and add type in layout

does: Turn one usable product photograph into a full marketplace and social set without a reshoot
machinery: product-composition-set.md; data/product-compositions.csv; scripts/plan_composition_set.py; image-editing.md; scripts/compile_prompt.py; scripts/generate_image.py --mode edit
refuses: A variant that changed the label, the closure, the quantity or the proportion of the product
what_it_does_not_do: Fix a source photo with no usable detail. Below a floor of source quality, reshoot

does: Build the masters and the manifest: real files, named, versioned, with owners and approval state
refuses: A blind Cartesian product of every format crossed with every message
what_it_does_not_do: Claim a render happened. _meta/render-capability.json stays not-rendered until files exist

does: Recompose each master for its placement, leaving the bands the app draws its own interface over empty
refuses: Resizing in place of recomposing, and a spec quoted from memory rather than the live source
what_it_does_not_do: Know today's spec. Platform dimensions change; verify against the official page

does: Gate the work on product truth, claims, rights, disclosure, accessibility, craft and continuity
machinery: anti-ai-quality.md; creative-evaluation.md; claims-proof-ledger.md; rights-and-claims.md; data/slop-tells.csv; scripts/score_creative.py
refuses: Passing a claim with no evidence row, and passing a person's likeness with no consent record
what_it_does_not_do: Substitute for legal review on a regulated category

does: Close the operational questions: what runs where, under whose name, tracked how, decided when
refuses: Publishing, buying media, contacting anyone or changing a live campaign without explicit authorisation
what_it_does_not_do: Push the button. The skill prepares the launch; a person launches it

does: Report what happened against what was intended, with the achievement arithmetic done by branch
refuses: A total printed from a card with a missing actual, and a channel metric offered as commercial value
what_it_does_not_do: Attribute. Correlated timing is not causation, and last-click is not attribution

does: Separate proposition, audience, creative, channel, landing, offer, timing and measurement failure
refuses: Naming the creative as the cause because it is the easiest thing to change
what_it_does_not_do: Prove the cause from one campaign. It ranks candidates and names the test that would settle it

does: Turn the diagnosis into ranked changes, held controls, one-variable tests and an explicit stop decision
refuses: Changing three variables at once and then claiming to know which one worked
what_it_does_not_do: Rescue a weak proposition with creative iteration. Some diagnoses route back to position
